The [[Crocodile]] is a [[charmable animal]] that can be found south of [[Blacktide Den]], in the western swamp of [[Lahtenda Bog]]. Crocodiles have highly tuned sensory organs, making them both excellent hunters and very sensitive, as a crocodile's hearing is so acute that a mother can actually hear unhatched babies inside their eggs.
